key_facts: The Pentagon and Northrop Grumman signed a combined $3 billion framework agreement covering Patriot and THAAD interceptor components under dual seven-year deals.
Northrop will become a second supplier of rocket motors for the Patriot and will increase structural component manufacturing for THAAD interceptors.
L3Harris signed a separate seven-year framework agreement to triple propulsion components for the Patriot interceptor.
Lockheed Martin announced a government award of up to $54 billion to accelerate its Patriot missile production.
CSIS reported the U.S. has used roughly a third of its Patriot interceptors and roughly half of its THAAD missiles since the start of the Iran war.
